blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Botanical conservatories, cloud-forest gardens, seasonal parks, landscape installations, color gardens, and environments designed around changes in light, scent, sound, and attention rather than monumental objects.
World relation: Crafted and Wild traditions overlap. The garden is designed, but weather and experience remain relational rather than fully controlled.
Connection to newer locations: The Garden Worlds connect to the Folded Garden of Six Traditions, Orchard of Borrowed Moons, Volcanic Orchard Caldera, Stormwall Orchard, and Redwood Rain Vault.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: Weather can be the mood of relations before it is a meteorological event. The environment changes what becomes noticeable without necessarily moving a single object.
